environment: STAGING isolated PostgreSQL restricted DML role

cases.name: Retail prices exclude VAT; exact discount and per-unit VAT give the same consumer total
Only a current Admin can read or save public retail settings, with bounded strict input
Settings use version checking, exact native retries and append-only audited receipts
Checkout stores server-priced immutable net, discount, VAT and gross without posting money or stock
Discount or catalog VAT changes reject stale quotes while retries keep the original order and total
Inactive, mismatched packages and discontinued public products cannot become free or purchasable
Native MCP can discover/read/update retail settings and read policy/current settings data safely
Pre-upgrade orders without quote or acknowledgement fields still replay their frozen receipt
Concurrent same-version Admin changes allow one winner without duplicated audit
A retry that missed an uncommitted order replays it after a concurrent discount commit
